item.title: Mapping FullVisitorId to Multiple ClientId in Google Analytics
item.description:
Introduction

In the realm of Google Analytics, the uniqueness of fullVisitorId and clientId as identifiers has been a topic of interest. While conventionally believed to have a one-to-one mapping, instances have been reported where a single fullVisitorId is linked to multiple clientId. This post delves into the exploration of this possibility and the circumstances under which it occurs.

Understanding FullVisitorId and ClientId in Google Analytics

Before delving into the potential one-to-many mapping, a brief review of these identifiers is in order.
